frequency_question: How often do emerging market central banks deploy incremental reserve ratios when managing sudden liquidity overhangs within a defined multi-month window?
membership_rule: Includes official central bank interventions mandating incremental reserve ratios on incremental deposits; excludes standard statutory liquidity ratio changes or regular open market operations.
